info.title: Lazer Hermes API
info.description: Lazer Hermes is a service that provides lazer prices in Hermes format.

get.summary: **Deprecated: use /v2/updates/price/{publish_time} instead** Get a single price update at or after a given publish time.
get.description:
**Deprecated: use /v2/updates/price/{publish_time} instead**

Get a single price update at or after a given publish time.

Given a price feed id and a publish time, retrieve the first Pyth price update whose publish_time is >= the provided value.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the price feed to query.

parameters.name: publish_time
parameters.description:
The unix timestamp in seconds. This endpoint will return the first update whose
publish_time is >= the provided value.

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.description: If true, include the `metadata` field in the response with additional metadata about the price update.

parameters.name: binary
parameters.description: If true, include the binary price update in the `vaa` field. This binary data can be submitted to Pyth contracts to update the on-chain price.

get.summary: **Deprecated: use /v2/updates/price/{publish_time} instead** Get a VAA in CCIP-compatible format.
get.description:
**Deprecated: use /v2/updates/price/{publish_time} instead**

Get a VAA in a format consumable by Chainlink CCIP off-chain reads.

The `data` parameter is a 40-byte hex payload: 32 bytes of price feed id followed by an 8-byte big-endian unix timestamp.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description:
40-byte hex-encoded payload (with optional `0x`/`0X` prefix). Bytes 0..32 are the
price feed id; bytes 32..40 are the publish time as an `i64` big-endian unix
timestamp.

502.description: VAA not available yet, or the history query failed

get.summary: **Deprecated: use /v2/updates/price/latest instead** Get the latest price updates by price feed id.
get.description:
**Deprecated: use /v2/updates/price/latest instead**

Get the latest price updates by price feed id.

Given a collection of price feed ids, retrieve the latest Pyth price for each price feed.

parameters.name: ids[]
parameters.description:
Get the most recent price update for this set of price feed ids.

This parameter can be provided multiple times to retrieve multiple price updates,
for example see the following query string:

```
?ids[]=a12...&ids[]=b4c...
```

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.description: If true, include the `metadata` field in the response with additional metadata about the price update.

parameters.name: binary
parameters.description: If true, include the binary price update in the `vaa` field of each returned feed. This binary data can be submitted to Pyth contracts to update the on-chain price.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: The channel to query for price updates. Defaults to `fixed_rate@1000ms` if not specified.

get.summary: **Deprecated: use /v2/updates/price/latest instead** Get the latest VAAs by price feed id.
get.description:
**Deprecated: use /v2/updates/price/latest instead**

Get the latest VAAs for a set of price feed ids.

Given a collection of price feed ids, retrieve the latest binary VAAs that bundle price updates for those feeds. The returned blobs can be submitted to Pyth contracts to update the on-chain price. If VAAs are not found for every provided price id the call will fail.

parameters.name: ids[]
parameters.description:
Get the most recent VAA for this set of price feed ids.

This parameter can be provided multiple times to retrieve multiple price updates,
for example see the following query string:

```
?ids[]=a12...&ids[]=b4c...
```

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: The channel to query for price updates. Defaults to `fixed_rate@1000ms` if not specified.

get.summary: **Deprecated: use /v2/price_feeds instead** Get the set of price feed IDs.
get.description:
**Deprecated: use /v2/price_feeds instead**

Get the set of price feed IDs.

This endpoint fetches all of the price feed IDs for which price updates can be retrieved.
Returns OK when the process is running.

Ready once at least one channel holds a fresh VAA -- the state every Hermes
price endpoint reads from. Channels are reported individually so a partial
outage is visible, but a single fresh channel is enough to serve traffic: a
shard need not produce updates for every rate.

get.summary: Get the guardian set upgrade VAA.
get.description: Queries all configured router guardians for their signed guardian set upgrade data, verifies signatures, assembles a complete Wormhole VAA, and returns it.

200.description: Guardian set upgrade VAA assembled successfully

404.description: No guardian set upgrade in progress

get.summary: Get the set of price feeds.
get.description:
Get the set of price feeds.

This endpoint fetches all price feeds from the Pyth network. It can be filtered by asset type
and query string.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional query parameter. If provided, the results will be filtered to all price feeds whose symbol contains the query string. Query string is case insensitive.

parameters.name: asset_type
parameters.description: Optional query parameter. If provided, the results will be filtered by asset type. Possible values are crypto, equity, fx, metal, rates. Filter string is case insensitive.

get.summary: Get a single price feed by id.
get.description:
Get a single price feed by id.

Returns the same metadata the `/v2/price_feeds` list returns for this feed. Feeds that are absent from that list are not reachable here either.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the price feed to query, with or without the `0x` prefix. Case insensitive.

get.summary: SSE route handler for streaming price updates.
get.description:
SSE route handler for streaming price updates.

The connection will automatically close after 24 hours to prevent resource leaks.
Clients should implement reconnection logic to maintain continuous price updates.

parameters.name: ids[]
parameters.description:
Get the most recent price update for this set of price feed ids.

This parameter can be provided multiple times to retrieve multiple price updates,
for example see the following query string:

```
?ids[]=a12...&ids[]=b4c...
```

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: Optional encoding type. If true, return the price update in the encoding specified by the encoding parameter. Default is `hex`.

parameters.name: parsed
parameters.description: If true, include the parsed price update in the `parsed` field of each returned feed. Default is `true`.

parameters.name: allow_unordered
parameters.description: If true, allows unordered price updates to be included in the stream.

parameters.name: benchmarks_only
parameters.description: If true, only include benchmark prices that are the initial price updates at a given timestamp (i.e., prevPubTime != pubTime).

parameters.name: ignore_invalid_price_ids
parameters.description: If true, invalid price IDs in the `ids` parameter are ignored. Only applicable to the v2 APIs. Default is `false`.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: The channel to query for price updates. Defaults to `fixed_rate@1000ms` if not specified.

get.summary: Get price updates within a time interval.
get.description:
Get price updates within a time interval.

Given a collection of price feed ids, a publish time and an interval, retrieve every Pyth price update whose publish_time falls within the interval. The interval may not exceed 60 seconds, and a request may name at most 100 price feed ids.

parameters.name: publish_time
parameters.description: The unix timestamp in seconds of the start of the requested interval, inclusive.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description:
The length of the requested interval in seconds, added to `publish_time` to give
the inclusive end of the interval. May not exceed 60.

parameters.name: ids[]
parameters.description:
Get the price updates within the requested interval for this set of price feed ids.

This parameter can be provided multiple times to retrieve multiple price updates,
for example see the following query string:

```
?ids[]=a12...&ids[]=b4c...
```

The unbracketed spelling `?ids=a12...&ids=b4c...` is accepted as well.
Providing both spellings in one request is an error.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: Optional encoding type. If true, return the price update in the encoding specified by the encoding parameter. Default is `hex`.

parameters.name: parsed
parameters.description: If true, include the parsed price update in the `parsed` field of each returned feed. Default is `true`.

parameters.name: ignore_invalid_price_ids
parameters.description: If true, invalid price IDs in the `ids` parameter are ignored. Only applicable to the v2 APIs. Default is `false`.

parameters.name: unique
parameters.description:
If true, only count the first update at each publish time, so a price
republished within a second appears once. Default is `true`.

get.summary: Get the most recent publisher stake caps update data.
get.description: Queries all configured router guardians for their share of the publisher stake caps VAA, assembles it, and returns the update data. Lazer does not compute stake caps, so it republishes the caps of the final Pythnet update.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: Optional encoding type. If true, return the message in the encoding specified by the encoding parameter. Default is `hex`.

parameters.name: parsed
parameters.description: If true, include the parsed update in the `parsed` field of each returned feed. Default is `true`.

200.description: Publisher stake caps update data retrieved successfully

RpcPrice.description:
A price with a degree of uncertainty at a certain time, represented as a price +- a confidence
interval.

The confidence interval roughly corresponds to the standard error of a normal distribution.
Both the price and confidence are stored in a fixed-point numeric representation, `x *
10^expo`, where `expo` is the exponent. For example:

conf.description: The confidence interval associated with the price, stored as a string to avoid precision loss

expo.description:
The exponent associated with both the price and confidence interval. Multiply those values
by `10^expo` to get the real value.

price.description: The price itself, stored as a string to avoid precision loss

publish_time.description:
When the price was published. The `publish_time` is a unix timestamp, i.e., the number of
seconds since the Unix epoch (00:00:00 UTC on 1 Jan 1970).

allow_unordered.description: If true, allows unordered price updates to be included in the stream.

benchmarks_only.description: If true, only include benchmark prices that are the initial price updates at a given timestamp (i.e., prevPubTime != pubTime).
